requester_requirements: Visible new electrical topic and supplied image use; detailed storm scene and criteria are independently authored test choices.
phenomena_pair: horizontal intracloud lightning and localized pointed-metal corona

hard_agent_test_gates.criterion: A bright branching channel or network extends primarily horizontally within a storm cloud. Cloud volume is lit internally and its visible forks remain above the sea horizon.
hard_agent_test_gates.observable: The cloud channel has separate visible branches, broad cloud diffusion and a distant cloud carrier.
hard_agent_test_gates.fail_or_uncertain: Only a featureless glow, painted lines, or an apparent long mast-to-cloud connecting arc does not pass.

hard_agent_test_gates.criterion: Compact blue-violet brush-like luminous filaments originate at exposed pointed metal tips on the nearby signal mast. The tips and tiny corona are visibly attached and localized.
hard_agent_test_gates.observable: At least one clearly recognizable sharp carrier tip with delicate local filament structure; the baseline targets two distinct tips.
hard_agent_test_gates.fail_or_uncertain: A blue LED dot, ordinary reflection, combustion flame or distant sky bolt coinciding with the mast does not pass.

hard_agent_test_gates.criterion: The mast corona and cloud lightning can both be located and distinguished by carrier, morphology and scale in the same native image.
hard_agent_test_gates.observable: Dark/neutral space and depth separate localized nearby tip glow from the broad distant branching cloud channel.
hard_agent_test_gates.fail_or_uncertain: One continuous electrical beam, or one effect too weak to recognize, prevents a pass.

hard_agent_test_gates.criterion: The observer visibly secures the log with one hand while the other grasps the casement latch; page curl, spray or narrowing window gap makes her purpose readable.
hard_agent_test_gates.observable: At least the two physical targets and corresponding hand contact are identifiable; a viewer can infer she is protecting a record from weather.
hard_agent_test_gates.fail_or_uncertain: Generic standing/gazing with disconnected props or unclear hand ownership does not pass.

hard_agent_test_gates.criterion: The woman’s face and dark chin-length bob with fine center fringe plausibly resemble the supplied reference at the chosen scale.
hard_agent_test_gates.observable: Specific face shape, eye/nose/lip proportions and bob silhouette are assessable.
hard_agent_test_gates.fail_or_uncertain: Unassessable small/hidden face or substantially different hair/face does not pass.

supplemental_review: Describe whole-image impression without control labels before calibration.
Judge hierarchy and emotional credibility separately from topic fidelity.
A static image can support visible physical relations; it cannot measure real electric field or prove an actual discharge mechanism.
Technical audit pass, perceived artistic effect and user acceptance remain separate.
repair_policy: Report any native gate failure or generation error to coordinator before further generation.
